Name: Rey Mod Menu
Author: LuiguiOS
Description:
[center][font=Impact][size=6]👑 Rey Mod Menu 👑[/size]
[/font][/center]
[center][b][size=3]Rey Mod Menu is a mod menu I created to bring a bunch of useful Stardew Valley tools together in one place.[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3]Instead of having separate commands or tools for different parts of the game, Rey Mod Menu gives you an in game interface where you can manage items, relationships, skills, experience, quests and other parts of your save.
[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]This is the [b]first public release[/b] of the mod. I've been using and improving it privately before releasing it here.[/size][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[left][b][size=4]Current language:[/size]
[/b][/left]
[left]The menu is currently available [b]in Spanish only[/b].
[/left]
[left]An English version isn't available yet, but I may add English support in a future update.[/left]
[heading][size=4]What can you do with it?[/size][/heading]
Rey Mod Menu currently includes:

[list]
[*]Browse and manage items through the item catalog.[/*]
[*]Search items and browse them by category.[/*]
[*]Manage relationships with NPCs.[/*]
[*]View and manage family information.[/*]
[*]Change skills and experience.[/*]
[*]Access mastery related options.[/*]
[*]Manage quests and progression.[/*]
[*]View diagnostic information about your game.[/*]
[*]Support for vanilla NPCs as well as characters from [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and [b]Ridgeside Village[/b].[/*]
[/list]You don't need SVE or Ridgeside Village to use the mod. Their characters simply become available in the corresponding parts of the menu when those mods are installed.
[heading][size=4]Requirements[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Optional:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Ridgeside Village[/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you don't already have it.[/*]
[*]Download Rey Mod Menu and extract the ZIP.[/*]
[*]Move the [b]ReyModMenu[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]That's it. The mod should load automatically with the game.

[heading][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
Rey Mod Menu was made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and runs through [b]SMAPI[/b].

It also has additional relationship support for Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village.
[heading]Version[/heading]
[b]1.4.1 — Initial public release[/b]

Previous versions were private development versions. Version 1.4.1 is the first version released publicly.
